```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the iris dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a pairplot with seaborn to visualize relationships
pairplot = sns.pairplot(df, hue='species', diag_kind='kde', markers=["o", "s", "D"])

# Add title and adjust plot
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Pairplot of Iris Dataset', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
